Toluwalemi is actively open to new roles and is available to start within two weeks of an offer. He is also open to relocation and available for immediate conversations with hiring teams.

If you'd like to reach him directly, the best way is via email at toluwalemisrael@gmail.com or through LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/toluwalemioluwadare.

Toluwalemi is primarily interested in AI Engineering roles — positions where he can work at the intersection of backend engineering and AI systems. This includes roles involving building and improving RAG pipelines, integrating LLMs into production products, designing agentic systems, or working on AI infrastructure and tooling.

# About Toluwalemi Oluwadare

Toluwalemi Oluwadare — often called "Tolu" — is a Software Engineer based in Nigeria with over five years of experience building scalable backend systems for startups across healthtech, fintech, and agritech. His primary language is Python, and his go-to stack is Python, Django, and AWS.

What sets Toluwalemi apart is that he bridges two worlds that rarely meet: deep backend engineering experience and a business education.

e bridges two worlds that rarely meet: deep backend engineering experience and a business education. He is currently pursuing an MBA in Entrepreneurship and Operations Management at the University of Ibadan, which means he thinks about systems not just in terms of performance and correctness, but in terms of business impact, operational efficiency, and organisational strategy.

He has spent the bulk of his career inside fast-moving startups where he has worn multiple hats — from hands-on backend

lk of his career inside fast-moving startups where he has worn multiple hats — from hands-on backend engineer to technical lead — and has developed a strong sense of what it means to ship software that actually moves a business forward.
